description: Dear Neighbors, I hope this email finds you well. With June 14 upon us, even a year later, we’re still mourning the loss of our friend Melissa, her husband Mark, and their beloved golden retriever Gilbert, who were assassinated in an act of political violence. My friend Melissa was a singular force for good in […]
title: Remembering Our Colleague Melissa Hortman - Youakim for State Representative
